metadata.title: Audionautix: Acoustic
metadata.description: Jason Shaw's music is a great resource for anyone interested in using CC licensed music in their next project. This is a collection of his acoustic, folk, and country tracks.
metadata.creator: Jason Shaw

reviews.reviewbody:
rich guitar sounds and nicely spaced piano playing
track 1 sounds like soundtrack to a journey - maybe a welcoming journey from sleep to waking?
nice hard steel sound on track 2
and track 14 sounds a bit like one of nick drake's instrumentals
very competent musicianship
eclectic and wide ranging, which is surprising as the limit of a genre is given on the cover. but its not a limited sound.

I will be making videos with pictures of my road trips with these wonderful tunes ♥ (I will credit them all of course!). Thank you for sharing such a rich collection, sweet and earthy sounds, I love it!
This music is great if you are looking to just play it casually anywhere at any time. It is also great for how-to or DIY videos.

metadata.creator: Pierce Murphy
metadata.description: Written in Japan in 2014 and initially released as a limited run CD for a 2017 Japanese tour, "来日 / To Japan" is the story of a journey through that beautiful country in search for a way to spare a blossoming love from the wake of the world. Each song was written in the cities they reference, and sound samples recorded in the trains, streets, and izakayas of Japan serve as sonic transitions from place to place. This was a labor of love.
metadata.title: 来日 / To Japan
